avis.texte: BRING BACK THE OLD FORMULA….PLEASE!! I have used this product for years and it was the best serum I had ever experienced! It made my sensitive, dry skin so supple and flawless. As a male, it even soothe and heal my razor bumps after shaving. Not to mention, felt more hydrated and calmed my skin. The new formula feels too watery, does not absorb well into the skin and leaves a lackluster finish. It's not hydrating and the ingredients in this watery based formula does not feel as effective as the old gel formula. I did not get the exact same results as I did with the old formula. Lastly, there is a significant size difference for the price! Why ruined something that was so good in the first place? I am completely disappointed and will be looking for a new serum product to replace the old version of ballet is repeating for years! Thanks for running away a devoted, repeat customer since 2019.
Product is great but new packing is 70% less (7 ounces less) for only a dollar less. What a scam, Ill be finding a new serum.

I just love the Consistency of this product. It works for all skin types and I don't smell sny scent to it, also easy application. Great value. I would recommend this product to my friends.
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum was so refreshing and made my face feel so hydrated. It goes on clear and moisturizing.

I very much like this serum. Let me explain why to me it's not the best serum, although I believe it helps keep my skin from feeling dry, it does not give me that feeling of hydration. Now, my face feels soft and clear. I'm not sure how to explain it, maybe it's just that way it gets absorbed. I guess it does not give me that dewey look when you wear moisturizer. Also when I first apply it feels a bit itchy for a good 5 seconds and then the feeling disappears. Maybe my skin is not used to one of the ingredients? I do like the serum though, I think it does its job. I would like it if I could get that "oh look at the face so hydrated look" . Overall I think it's pretty decent and I also like that it comes in a tube. I normally use 2 pumps to distribute around my whole face and neck. I also like that it's not sticky. I don't like sticky things and this serum goes on very smoothly.
I used this before running out in the cold and it actually helped keep my face from drying out in the cold and wind. I haven't found another product that does this. Would definitely repurchase
Just started using this product so far it's hydrated my skin very nicely, doesn't have a scent no breakouts my skin feels rejuvenated after using this serum.

I wanted to love this product. It boost hydration, it leaves your skin feeling very soft and plump. I love my skin is left looking radiant, I go to every day look is a dewy finish. It has hyaluronic acid, which again helps your skin look plump which gives appearance of less fine lines. My only issue is the price for the size. It's on the small side, and I feel like there are other products that you get more bang for your buck. With that said I would possibly repurchase in the future because I do think my skin looks nice after use.
It feels great going on and it absorbs into the skin fairly quickly. It doesn't leave a film behind you just have to trust it's doing its job. I have fairly sensitive skin and I've had no issues

I received First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Hydration Boost Serum free for my honest review. I love that it doesn't have a scent that I can tell. It hasn't irritated my skin bonus my skin looks plumper. I totally recommend.

I really love the first aid beauty line. It's one of the more affordable skincare lines out there, and it has products for all skin types and problem areas. This hydration serum is lightweight and non greasy. You apply the product day and night, and you can layer it under thicker products.
Didn't live up to what product claimed would do. Also don't be alarmed but the bottle looks normal size but it's basically half full. Not good!

I love this so much, almost as much as I loved the bounce boost serum (bring it back!!!) Great formula that makes my skin look full, hydrated and healthy. I do wish they would specify that you need to apply to damp skin in order for the product to work properly as it seems that many people who complain of issues with hyaluronic acid are applying to dry skin. I layer this under the hydrating gel cream for an intensely quenching but weightless daily moisturizer routine

I have very dry, occasionally dehydrated, moderately sensitive skin. I also prefer cruelty free products. And, I really don't want to break the bank on skincare products. Its not easy to find the combo I need but FAB checks all the boxes! I love this serum. Its very hydrating, doesn't just sit on the skin, it absorbs well. A little goes a long way too, so one bottle lasts a few months. I've been using this for about 8 mos, fall-spring. Chicago winters are rough on my skin, I walk about 1.5 miles to and from the train 4 days a week. This serum stood up to the test. I highly recommend.

avis.titre: Where is the "bounce-boosting serum"? Is this it?
avis.texte: Is this the same as the "voice-Boosting Serum" with hydroponic acids and peptides? I am looking to reorder and cannot find it. Haaaaalp

avis.titre: Best hyaluronic acid serum in an affordable price
avis.texte: Best hyaluronic acid serum in an affordable price range! I used an Obagi Hydro-drops for years and while I loved it.. The smell and the price were huge downsides. I also lost a lot of product due to the packaging. I got my first bottle of FAB Hydrating Serum in a subscription box. It feels so luxe like my old drops without the high price and scent. I love the pump vs a dropper or squeeze bottle. It just feels so spoiled and luxurious to use this. It doesn't break me out, it wears beautifully under my spf and skin tint, and it's lasted a while. I'm ordering a new one today to replace the one in almost out of. New holy grail item for me! When the pump runs out, I'll see about what's left in the container but hopefully I can get a lot more out versus the more expensive one. A lot of reviews compare this to the old one, which I can't speak to, but as a new First Aid Beauty customer new to this formula, I love it. It does have that "sticky" finish to it but I don't feel like it's overly sticky and within a few minutes I can start layering other products on or head out the door. Just beautiful!
I have used the ultra repair hydrating serum og formula for over 6 years. It is the best thing for my sensitive skin. I NEED IT BACK. The new formulas are just not as good. I'm begging.

One of the few hydrating serums that doesn't break me out. I use this over a hydrating facial spray and then top it with the FA Bounce serum and Ultra Repair cream. Never tried the old formula but am very happy with this one. On my third bottle.

I puchased a set and it had this serum. I tried it for a week and it broke me out. Ive worked hard to keep my skin clear. This wasnt hydrating at all it actually made my skin feel/look dull. Im sure if ive continued use it will destroy my skin. The acne was not "purge" my skin is adjusting it's pimples. I have combo more on the dry side, sensative, acne prone skin.

My skin has been feeling drier than usual, but also more sensitive to a thicker moisturizer. This saved the day! Very light, and soaks in well. I do a layer of this serum, then on top a day moisturizer. Works great. I feel hydrated and plump, not tacky and heavy.

I absolutely love everything FAB… but this one is a complete dud. It's oddly sticky. For 20-30 minutes after putting it on, it feels like I could pick up pet hair and dust with my face — like a lint roller! I've been using for a couple months and don't really notice a difference in hydration either. It doesn't seem to actually penetrate your skin, maybe that's why it's so sticky. I don't know. Funny thing is, I remember getting a sample of this product a long time ago and really liking it. Other reviews say the formula changed so… that tracks I guess. I hope they come out with something different or go back to the old formula because I really would like to incorporate more serums into my skin care!

I tried the First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Hydrating Serum and it was wonderful, however it has been so hard to find and I can only assume based off some of the other reviews it is because the product has an updated formula. I want the one I tried not this one with the hyaluronic acid so I've been going store to store just to find someone who may have the old formula stocked. What's worse is I don't see anything from the brand mentioning the new change

I'm on my third bottle of this now. If you are looking for an intensely lightweight moisturizer for the Summer I highly recommend. I have dry, mature skin and this paid well with FAB Hyaluronic Acid. The moisturizer has an amazing silky texture, goes on light/airy and leaves a slight dewy shine (love). I use it for my day/night routines. If you are drier like I am I wouldn't suggest using during the winter but I think an oily skin type would do well.

Please bring back the old formula. This new one leaves my skin sticky and it never fully sets in. Because it never fully sets in, my skin doesn't feel hydrated. FAB saved my skin when I transitioned to dry, more mature skin.
Wow this stuff really makes my Skin look bright and glowy. I love it so much! My 44 year old skin is very happy :)
I use this everyday and I have extremely sensitive skin and my skin feels great after I use it.

I have issues with bumpy texture (from lack of hydration, probably) and this product helps get rid of it. I see the other review says it doesn't fully sink in. Idk what that means, but I think it does decently well. There is a small bit of a glow it leaves, maybe that's what they mean. But it makes you look youthful and well taken care of. It's not over the top. I put my daily face moisturizer from this brand over it and it didn't pill. I've only used it twice and have not experienced a rash or red bumps like others state. I think perhaps they got used their skin got used to the old formula. If you never tried their serums before and just start with this, I think it's fine and non-irritating. The ingredient list is non-irritating lol

avis.titre: I miss the Ultra repair serum
avis.texte: Ordered accidentally not realizing it wasn't the ultra repair serum and I'm so disappointed. The URS was the reason I bought fab and this isn't it. Will be searching for a new serum/brand immediately.

I'm in my early 40s with some dryness, hyperpigmentation and sensitive skin. I've been using this a little over a month. I will say if I give it a "half" of pump, enough will come out to cover entire face & part of neck. While I never had any reactions to this, I can't say over a month of using it I've seen much improvement in my skin. I use a few layers of 'higher' end products too & pay attention to the ingredients. I was hoping this would provide the extra hydration & improve appearance on skin, but can't say I've seen much of a difference than what I was using prior. I don't think I'll purchase this again.

Why did you change the formula? It was an excellent serum before you had to change it. It was also great for sensitive skin. You could have kept the basic hydrating serum and just made a separate lotion as new product. So frustrating!

I have been using the hydrating serum for years, always clean feeling, light, skin always glowed. This new formula is disgusting feeling on my skin, a mucus like texture that never seems to fully sink in, my skin feels dry after putting it on. THE WORST PART: my skin has broken out i have obvious inflammation from this new formula. I do have sensitive skin thats why I used the old formula daily never had an issue which I loved it so much for that reason. This new one tho, there are red bumps big and small around nose eyes lips cheeks i never have pimples in that area......theyre painful and inflammed.. I know it's this because I tried this new formula before and the same darn thing happened. This is crap. My face burns.. why do we need to do these lame revivals of products? I don't want squalene or whatever the heck it is in my simple face moisturizer. Anything to make a sale, whats the IN thing that'll last a year or 2. Then make it a separate product, leave the original. They are nothing alike in allllll the wrong ways... Booooooooooooo!!!!!

avis.titre: Really works for my very sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I love this serum; my face feels so much better when I'm using it. My skin is so sensitive I'm allergic to allergy-tested products, and I know everyone's skin is different but for me this stuff feels amazing and doesn't blow up my face. 10/10
